subject: Regional quiet-period: propose demo realignment to avoid OOO windows
messages:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick: Demo timing around regional quiet periods

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for agreeing to the initial product walkthrough next week. Two scheduling notes from our side that just landed:

- Our APAC engineering lead (Japan) will be largely OOO for a planning "quiet period" the week of May 4 next year (Golden Week overlap planning).
- Our India product manager flagged Diwali window constraints in late Oct/early Nov for next year; they want the customer-facing technical folks present for the full demo.

We started with a single 90-min slot (aiming to cover architecture and a short Q&A). Given the cross-region nature of our team, can we either:

1) Split into two 45-min sessions (one targeting APAC + EMEA daytime, one targeting US late-morning), or
2) Move to a single slot that lands in a narrow overlap (which I think would be early morning PST / late evening JST) — not ideal for either audience.

Also, FYI, our legal and procurement will want to be in the follow-up if we move into an eval — they'll be in different regions and may ask for separate collateral.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Run two shorter sessions with the same content and a shared recording, or
- Split the demo into a technical deep-dive and a product overview on separate days?

We prefer to pick options now so we don't have to reshuffle when the local quiet weeks are posted.

Thanks,
Sam Jenkins
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Retail

(attachment: requirements_matrix.xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Demo timing around regional quiet periods

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads-up and for calling out both Golden Week and Diwali planning windows. Good to know now.

Short answer: we can do either approach. My recommendation (based on similar global accounts):

- Option A (recommended): Two 45-min sessions. Keep the first session focused on product-level value + live demo (public audience friendly). Second session is a technical 45-min for your engineers (deep dive, arch, integrations).
- Option B: Single 75–90 min slot in the overlap window if you really need everyone in one place. Note: that pushes US participants early and APAC late.

Concrete windows we can offer next month (all times listed with local offsets; please confirm preferred timezone):
- APAC-friendly session: Tue, 2027-01-12 10:00–10:45 JST / Mon, 2027-01-11 18:00–18:45 PST
- US-friendly session: Wed, 2027-01-13 10:00–10:45 PST / Wed, 2027-01-13 18:00–18:45 CET
- Single overlap slot (if needed): Thu, 2027-01-14 08:30–10:00 PST / Thu, 2027-01-14 00:30–02:00 JST (late-night JPN)

Notes:
- We accounted for DST differences: after Nov 2026 the US has already rolled back, EU DST ends earlier, so the hour offsets stabilize in January.
- We can record both sessions and provide a single recording + a short Q&A digest.

Attached is a short plan with split-session agendas and roles (sales vs. engineers).

Options look flexible; Lauren — can you confirm engineer availability for the APAC deep-dive on Jan 12? Aditya — can you own the tech Q&A if we run two sessions?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(attachment: acme-demo-multi-window-proposal.pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Demo timing around regional quiet periods

Vivek / Sam — I can do Jan 12 APAC slot (10:00 JST).

A couple of pragmatic suggestions:
- Keep the APAC session tightly scoped: 30–40 min demo + 10–15 min live Q&A (engineers often join for the tail end).
- For the US session, include a short 10-min customer success segment to cover onboarding and support SLOs — that helps procurement feel included.

If everyone is OK, I'd send two calendar invites (one for each audience) and include a shared recording and an internal runbook for follow-ups. Vivek: I added brief notes to the attached plan re: roles.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
(attachment: acme-demo-multi-window-proposal.pdf)

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-retail.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick: Demo timing around regional quiet periods

Vivek / Lauren / Aditya — thanks, that all sounds good. We prefer Option A (two sessions). Confirming:

- APAC session: Tue, 2027-01-12 10:00–10:45 JST — Attendees: Japan Eng Lead, India PM (Priya), APAC Solutions.
- US/EMEA session: Wed, 2027-01-13 10:00–10:45 PST / 18:00–18:45 CET — Attendees: US Eng, EMEA Product, Procurement (TBD).

Please send separate calendar invites and include the recording link afterward. Also: can you attach the short runbook and the checklist for procurement (we'll loop legal once procurement confirms)?
